transcript.text: Good evening everyone. We've got the Alpha furnace campaign scheduled for tonight, with Beta available as an alternate. Before I authorize anything, I need to go through our normal pre-start routine. I'd like to hear from process engineering and environmental health and safety on their final checks. Also, given our nitrogen supply situation — we have 1,000 normal cubic meters available before the next delivery after tomorrow's day shift — I want to make sure we understand the inerting requirements for whichever campaign we run. Can process engineering confirm the nitrogen requirements for Alpha, and do we have any concerns about supply?

transcript.text: I completed a validated process calculation this morning that shows the Alpha campaign requires exactly 1,200 normal cubic meters of nitrogen, while the Beta campaign requires exactly 600 normal cubic meters.
